title: 4chan whistleblower: underwater mobile construction units building UAP
place_text: ocean floor near the Bahamas / Bermuda Triangle

tellings.quote: that his job was to they were monitoring these underground or underwater what they called mobile construction units, these massive,

plain: An anonymous poster on 4chan, an online message board where users do not give their names, claimed his job had been to monitor huge underwater "mobile construction units" on the ocean floor near the Bahamas and the Bermuda Triangle, which were said to be building unidentified craft. The YouTuber Chris Ramsay retells the post on the show. If true, something would be building craft under the sea.
